title: Food Chain
definition: A linear sequence of organisms through which nutrients and energy pass as one organism eats another, representing the unidirectional flow of energy in an ecosystem.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to understanding ecosystem services, bioaccumulation, biomagnification, and environmental impact assessments (EIA).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Food Chain.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
